# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 97 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 50-51 | Coptic

---

## Saying 97

Jesus said: "The kingdom of the Father is like a woman who was carrying a jar filled with grain. While she was walking along a road at some distance from home, the handle of the jar broke and the grain poured out behind her along the road. She was unaware of this; she had not noticed. When she arrived at her house, she set down the jar and found it empty."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "Grain" over "meal" — the Coptic *pōfs* can mean either grain or flour/meal
- "Poured out behind her" — the gradual loss made visible
- "She was unaware of this; she had not noticed" — the double statement of obliviousness preserved
